question: Should `agent-transcript` be allowed to discover local GitHub Copilot session-state files as an input to a tool that can prepare text for public PR or issue bodies?
rationale: The code can reduce disclosure risk through whitelisting and redaction, but it cannot decide the repository’s acceptable local-session-data boundary or whether Copilot session discovery belongs in the shared public skill.

options.title: Approve a narrow Copilot source policy
options.body: Accept Copilot session discovery with the proposed visible-dialogue whitelist and fail-closed exclusions, then continue normal maintainer review.

options.title: Require explicit product constraints first
options.body: Keep the PR open while maintainers define additional consent, invocation, or data-retention constraints before choosing an implementation.

options.title: Keep Copilot sessions out of the shared skill
options.body: Decline this data source for the public shared workflow and close the feature direction without merging it.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow Copilot source policy
recommendation.body: Accept Copilot session discovery with the proposed visible-dialogue whitelist and fail-closed exclusions, then continue normal maintainer review.
